## What's Changed
* Fixed: StructuredQueries 0.38 support (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/540).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/compare/1.11.1...1.11.2

* Infrastructure: Bump to support IssueReporting 2.1 (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/491).

* Added: `StrictDecoding`, a trait that throws an error when a decoded field's type doesn't match its SQL affinity (https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/pull/489).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/pointfreeco/sqlite-data/compare/1.9.0...1.10.0

## Inboxes

- Threads tab: a **Filter** button with Unread / Read, labels, and Needs attention (awaiting approval, held / quarantined, has attachments). Active filters show as removable chips and stay in the URL.
- With a thread open, the thread list and the thread scroll independently on desktop.
- Replies, new emails, and the Reply / Forward dialog on received mail use the block editor. It now has the `/` block menu, a menu on text selection, and an expand toggle with the full toolbar. Button blocks are s

## Sending

- The tags `feedback_id_a` and `feedback_id_b` on `POST /emails` and `POST /emails/batch` now go into the email's `Feedback-ID` header as `<a>:<b>:<SES id>:AmazonSES`, for Gmail's feedback loop in Postmaster Tools. Values must be letters, digits, `_` or `-`, up to 256 characters; any other value stays a tag but is left out of the header. SES signs the header with its own `amazonses.com` DKIM key.

No migrations.

## Audience

- **Fix:** narrowing the contacts list (and its CSV export) to a manual segment listed no one, and a filter segment left out contacts added to it by hand. Both now resolve a segment the way broadcasts and segment counts do.
- With a manual segment selected, the date column shows when each contact joined the segment ("Added to segment"), with the contact's own creation date beneath.
- With a filter segment selected, the column reads "Contact added", with a tooltip explaining that a filter segmen

## Content monitor

- Risk lines default to 0.85 flag, 0.9 alert, 0.95 pause.
- The judge is told the team's own domains (verified sending domains, plus members' verified sign-in domains once mail to them has cleared screening).
- A team's own Pix code, Pix QR or boleto in its own order notice is no longer read as a payment lure.
- Destination clearance is taken back only on a verdict of 90 or more naming a hold category or reason; major platforms and consumer mailboxes are never revoked.
- The daily screen

- **Migration `0067`** adds two counters to `usage_counters`, `excluded_sent` and `excluded_hard_bounced`, both `0` by default. Postgres adds them without rewriting the table, so it is quick on any instance.
